executive_summary: The Indian stock market experienced minor losses, with IT and Auto sectors showing gains, while the US stock market closed mixed with the Nasdaq down 0.32% and S&P 500 down 0.05%. Global markets are volatile due to geopolitics and AI-related trends, with governments and companies making significant moves in the AI market. The HR landscape in India is seeing a decline in hiring, with an emphasis on acquiring AI skills, and central banks are holding rates steady amid inflation concerns. These trends suggest a shift towards technology and AI-driven growth, with potential implications for economic stability and workforce development.
